TWODSIX_LEDGER.ADD_EXISTING_LOAN_HINT: For a debt you already have. No money is added to your accounts.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CALENDAR_TOOLTIP: Traveller calendar: 13 months of 28 days, plus one extra day (Holiday) at the start of the year, 365 days in all. An item per month is paid once per month, an item per year once per year.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.ERROR_NO_FUNDS: There is not enough money on that account.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.ERROR_INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount, for example 200 or -200.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.ERROR_MOVE_AMOUNT: Enter a positive amount to move.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.MOVE_HINT: Moves money between your own accounts. Total funds do not change.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.NET_OF_DEBT_HINT: Total funds minus what you owe.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.NO_LOANS: No debts. Take a loan, or add a debt you already have.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.NO_RECURRING: No recurring items yet. Add rent, ship payments, a pension or anything else you pay or receive regularly.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.PAY_NO_FUNDS: There is not enough money on that account.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.PAY_NO_DEBT: There is no debt left to pay.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.REAL_DATE_TOOLTIP: Real-world date. No in-game date was recorded.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.RECURRING_HINT: You pay by hand. Each payment becomes an entry in the history. Use − for costs and + for income.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.UNDO_CONFIRM: Remove the newest entry (_ENTRY_) and undo its effect on your balances?
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CONFIG_HINT: Which accounts and categories the ledger has, for every character in this world.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CONFIG_ACCOUNTS_HINT: Up to {max} accounts. Cash is the sheet's own field and is always first; you can rename it. Leave a name empty to use the standard name.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CONFIG_CATEGORIES_HINT: The standard categories can be renamed but not removed, because the ledger uses them. You can add your own.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CONFIG_CATEGORY_LOCKED: A standard category cannot be removed
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CONFIG_IN_USE: {account} is still used by {actor} (a balance, a history entry, an item or a loan) and cannot be removed.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CONFIG_CATEGORY_NAME: A category you add needs a name.
TWODSIX_LEDGER.CONFIG_ACCOUNT_NAME: An account you add needs a name.
